hypotheses.buyer_and_moment: Adult child or spouse comparing home-care agencies after receiving proposals.
hypotheses.promised_result: A traceable apples-to-apples record of scope, scheduling, backup coverage, supervision, exclusions, price structure and unanswered questions.
hypotheses.content_and_format: US-focused 7.5x9.25 paperback reference plus write-in comparison packet; no medical, employment-law or care-plan advice.

price_hypothesis.basis: Adjacent current caregiver paperbacks are visibly sold around EUR7–10 and the direct old guide has no usable price; test $14.99 as a consequential-decision workbook anchor, not a final price.

paid_alternatives: home-care agency placement and care-management services
hypotheses.specific_advantage: Works against actual proposals and preserves what each agency said; it does not repeat a generic hiring checklist.
hypotheses.reachable_channel: Amazon exact-query shelf plus caregiver-resource search; employer caregiver programs are a possible later channel, not assumed.
hypotheses.main_unverified_assumption: Families will pay for proposal normalization rather than use the free checklist.

cheapest_test.not_authorized: One-page offer and four-page non-medical comparison packet shown to 8–12 people currently comparing agencies; ask for a real $12 purchase of the finished packet, with no preorder.
cheapest_test.signals: Record view, comprehension, purchase attempt and completed payment separately.

hypotheses.continue_if: At least 2 completed payments from 10 qualified current buyers and no recurring demand for medical/legal guidance.
hypotheses.reject_if: No completed payment after 10 qualified exposures, or buyers primarily want individualized care/legal advice.
hypotheses.anton_involvement: About 30 minutes to approve test packaging; no subject-matter judgment.

hypotheses.buyer_and_moment: Homeowner holding a professional energy-audit report before requesting retrofit quotes.
hypotheses.promised_result: Turn recommendations into staged quote requests, assumptions and a decision record.
hypotheses.content_and_format: Paperback reference and write-in action packet; no engineering or savings guarantee.

price_hypothesis.basis: Visible adjacent home-energy paperbacks cluster roughly around EUR8–21, but report-decoder demand is unobserved.

hypotheses.specific_advantage: Post-audit coordination across competing retrofit quotes rather than DIY auditing.
hypotheses.main_unverified_assumption: Post-audit homeowners seek a book-shaped coordination tool.

cheapest_test.not_authorized: Keyword-specific offer test against a four-page report-to-quote packet with 10 recent audit buyers; require completed payment, not stated interest.
cheapest_test.signals: Track view, click, request and completed payment separately.

hypotheses.continue_if: At least 2 completed payments from 10 qualified recent-audit homeowners.
hypotheses.reject_if: No payments or buyers expect engineering/savings advice.
hypotheses.anton_involvement: About 30 minutes to approve test packaging.
